11.heading: Then shall:
refs: This seems to refer to the future conversion and restoration of the Jews and Israelites, under on head, Jesus Christ
so that there shall be one flock and one shepherd.
An allusion to the word Jezreel. God who sowed them among the nations in His wrath, shall reap and gather them in His mercy. See Hos 2:22-23
